UNIFORM AND SHOP-TOWEL RENTAL SERVICE AGREEMENT

This Uniform and Shop-Towel Rental Service Agreement (this "Agreement") is made and entered into effective as of May 3, 2021 (the "Effective Date"), by and between Cintrella Uniform Services, Inc., an Ohio corporation ("Vendor"), and Meridian Mechanical Group, Inc., a Delaware corporation d/b/a Meridian Plumbing, Heating & Air, located at 2150 Harbor Point Drive, Suite 400, Sacramento, California 95833 ("Customer").

RECITALS

WHEREAS, Vendor is in the business of providing uniform and shop-towel rental services; and

WHEREAS, Customer desires to engage Vendor to provide uniform and shop-towel rental services at all ten (10) branch locations of Customer's business; and

WHEREAS, the parties desire to enter into this Agreement on the terms and conditions set forth herein.

NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements herein contained, the parties agree as follows:

1. DEFINITIONS

1.1 "Services" means the uniform and shop-towel rental services described in Section 2.

1.2 "Branch Locations" means the ten (10) branch locations of Customer in Sacramento, Stockton, Modesto, Fresno, Bakersfield, Los Angeles, San Diego, Las Vegas, Reno, and Carson City, as more particularly described in Exhibit A.

1.3 "Specifications" means the uniform styles, sizes, shop-towel specifications, and service frequency set forth in Exhibit A.

1.4 "Delivery Day" means the weekly delivery and pickup day established for each Branch Location as set forth in Exhibit A.

1.5 "Term" has the meaning set forth in Section 3.1.

2. SERVICES

2.1 Service Description. Vendor shall provide uniform rental and shop-towel laundry services to Customer at each of the ten (10) Branch Locations. Services shall include: (a) delivery and pickup of clean uniforms, shop coats, aprons, and related uniform items according to the Specifications; (b) laundering and cleaning of all uniforms and items in accordance with industry standards; (c) delivery and pickup of shop towels and floor mats for use in Customer's facilities and service vehicles; (d) replacement of worn, damaged, or missing items; and (e) weekly delivery and pickup service at each Branch Location on the designated Delivery Day.

2.2 Service Standards. Vendor shall maintain uniforms and towels in clean, sanitary condition and shall perform all services in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. All uniforms shall be properly sized, ready for use, and free from defects.

2.3 Initial Equipment. Vendor shall provide an initial inventory of uniforms and shop towels as set forth in Exhibit A at no additional charge beyond monthly rental fees.

2.4 Replacement Charges. Customer shall be responsible for reasonable wear and tear. Replacement charges for items lost, damaged beyond repair, or not returned are as follows: standard uniform shirts or pants, $28 per item; shop coats or specialized uniforms, $45 per item; shop towels or floor mats per dozen, $22. Customer shall notify Vendor of missing or damaged items within seven (7) business days of delivery. Charges shall be invoiced on the following month's invoice.

2.5 Service Changes. Customer may request changes to uniform specifications, quantities, or delivery frequency upon thirty (30) days' written notice. Any resulting charges or credits shall be applied prospectively.

3. TERM AND RENEWAL

3.1 Initial Term. This Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and continue for an initial term of sixty (60) months, expiring at 5:00 p.m. Pacific Time on May 2, 2026 (the "Initial Term"), unless earlier terminated in accordance herewith.

3.2 Automatic Renewal. Upon expiration of the Initial Term, this Agreement shall automatically renew for successive sixty (60) month terms on the same terms and conditions, unless either party delivers written notice of non-renewal not less than ninety (90) nor more than one hundred eighty (180) days prior to expiration of the then-current Term. Such notice must be delivered by registered mail, email with read receipt, or overnight courier.

3.3 Continuity of Service. If neither party provides timely non-renewal notice, the Agreement shall continue to renew automatically. Customer authorizes Vendor to charge Customer's account for all fees during any Renewal Term unless termination notice is provided under Section 3.2.

3.4 Material Changes. If Vendor implements material changes to the Services, locations, or terms during any Renewal Term, Vendor shall provide written notice at least one hundred twenty (120) days prior to such change. If Customer objects, Customer may terminate without penalty upon thirty (30) days' written notice delivered within thirty (30) days of receiving notice of the proposed change.

4. PRICING AND PAYMENT

4.1 Monthly Rental Fees. Customer shall pay Vendor the following weekly rental fees for Services at each Branch Location:

Sacramento: $425/week
Stockton: $385/week
Modesto: $375/week
Fresno: $395/week
Bakersfield: $385/week
Los Angeles: $485/week
San Diego: $425/week
Las Vegas: $415/week
Reno: $355/week
Carson City: $335/week

Monthly rental fees shall be calculated based on four (4) weeks per month, plus charges for any additional weeks with five (5) delivery days. The fees are inclusive of initial uniforms and all regularly scheduled deliveries. Total estimated annual fees for Year 1 shall be approximately $80,080.

4.2 Price Adjustments. Effective on each annual anniversary of the Effective Date, Vendor may increase weekly rental fees by up to five percent (5%) per year. Vendor shall provide Customer with notice of any price increase at least thirty (30) days prior to the anniversary date.

4.3 Billing and Payment. Vendor shall invoice Customer monthly in advance for the following month's Services. Invoices shall be due and payable within thirty (30) days of receipt. Customer shall remit payment via check, ACH transfer, or credit card as directed by Vendor. Invoices shall itemize fees by Branch Location and include any replacement charges.

4.4 Late Payment. Invoices not paid within thirty (30) days of receipt shall accrue a late payment fee of one and one-half percent (1.5%) per month on the outstanding balance, or the maximum rate permitted by law, whichever is less. If payment is not received within sixty (60) days, Vendor may suspend Services without liability.

4.5 Additional Services. Additional uniforms, shop towels, or services beyond those specified in Exhibit A shall be provided at Vendor's then-current rates and shall require a fifteen (15) day lead time where feasible. Special requests shall be billed separately.

5. MAINTENANCE AND CUSTOMER RESPONSIBILITIES

5.1 Proper Care. Customer shall ensure uniforms and shop towels are maintained in reasonable condition and used only for authorized business purposes. Customer shall not launder, dry clean, or attempt to repair such items.

5.2 Lost or Damaged Items. Customer shall be responsible for uniforms or shop towels lost or damaged due to Customer's negligence or failure to return items for pickup. Replacement charges set forth in Section 2.4 shall apply.

5.3 Return of Equipment. Upon termination for any reason, Customer shall return all uniforms, shop coats, shop towels, and equipment within five (5) business days. Replacement fees shall apply for items not returned in serviceable condition.

6. EARLY TERMINATION

6.1 Early Termination Fee. If Customer terminates this Agreement prior to expiration of the Initial Term or any Renewal Term (other than for Vendor's uncured material breach), Customer shall pay an early termination fee equal to fifty percent (50%) of all weekly rental charges that would have been due for the remainder of the then-current Term through the stated expiration date.

6.2 Calculation. By illustration: if Customer terminates on October 1, 2023 (approximately 29 months into the Initial Term with 31 months remaining), the early termination fee would equal fifty percent (50%) of weekly charges for the remaining 31 months, approximately $26,390 based on Year 1 pricing and assuming no increases.

6.3 Termination for Material Breach. Customer may terminate without incurring an early termination fee if Vendor materially breaches this Agreement and fails to cure within thirty (30) days following written notice specifying the breach. Material breaches include: failure to provide Services for more than ten (10) consecutive days, delivery of uniforms in unsanitary condition, or failure to replace items within thirty (30) days of written request.

6.4 Procedure. Any termination must be effected by written notice delivered by registered mail, overnight courier, or email with read receipt to the addresses in Section 10.1. Termination shall be effective no less than thirty (30) days from receipt of notice.

7. TERMINATION FOR CAUSE

7.1 Vendor's Right to Terminate. Vendor may terminate immediately upon written notice if Customer: (a) materially breaches this Agreement and fails to cure within thirty (30) days of written notice; (b) fails to pay any undisputed invoice within sixty (60) days; or (c) becomes insolvent or subject to bankruptcy proceedings.

8. LIABILITY AND INDEMNIFICATION

8.1 Limitation of Liability. Neither party shall be liable for indirect, incidental, consequential, special, or punitive damages, including lost profits or business opportunity, even if advised of such possibility.

8.2 Indemnification. Customer shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Vendor from third-party claims arising from Customer's use of uniforms or towels, Customer's failure to return items, or Customer's breach of this Agreement.

9. GOVERNING LAW AND DISPUTE RESOLUTION

9.1 Governing Law. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the State of Ohio, without regard to conflicts of law principles.

9.2 Jurisdiction. Each party irrevocably submits to the exclusive jurisdiction of state and federal courts in Cuyahoga County, Ohio, and waives objection to venue.

9.3 Dispute Resolution. Prior to legal action, parties shall attempt to resolve disputes through good faith negotiation by senior representatives within thirty (30) days.

10. GENERAL PROVISIONS

10.1 Notices. All notices shall be delivered personally, by overnight courier, email with read receipt, or registered mail to:

Vendor: Cintrella Uniform Services, Inc.
Attn: Contract Management
1420 Chester Avenue
Cleveland, Ohio 44114
Email: contracts@cintrella.com

Customer: Meridian Mechanical Group, Inc.
Attn: Vice President of Operations
2150 Harbor Point Drive, Suite 400
Sacramento, California 95833
Email: ops@meridianmechanical.com

10.2 Entire Agreement. This Agreement, together with Exhibit A, constitutes the entire agreement and supersedes all prior negotiations and understandings.

10.3 Amendment. This Agreement may not be amended except by written instrument signed by authorized representatives of both parties.

10.4 Assignment. Neither party may assign this Agreement without prior written consent of the other, except that Vendor may assign to any successor or affiliate that assumes all obligations, which shall not relieve Vendor of liability.

10.5 Severability. If any provision is found invalid or unenforceable, it shall be reformed to the minimum extent necessary, or if not possible, severed. Remaining provisions shall remain in full force and effect.

10.6 Waiver. No waiver of any provision or breach shall be effective unless in writing and signed by the party against which sought. No waiver of any breach constitutes waiver of any other breach.

10.7 Counterparts. This Agreement may be executed in counterparts, each deemed an original. Execution by electronic means (PDF or email) shall have the same force as manually executed originals.

10.8 Relationship of Parties. Nothing herein creates a partnership, joint venture, or agency relationship between the parties. Each is an independent contractor.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties execute this Agreement as of the date first written above.
